title: Portfolio, registry and correspondence operations in ANDS Studio
walkthrough:
You open the Portfolio page. A top bar shows "ANDS Studio · portfolio", a user chip, and chips: "Help", "Dossier manager", "Registry", "Correspondence", "Guided journey →". Under the "Portfolio" heading, text reads "Every product dossier in your organisation — module progress, filing gate and fee status at a glance." A smaller line notes every change is captured in the dossier's append-only audit trail — actor and workspace stamped, sequence-numbered, exportable for inspections (open a dossier → Audit). With no data you see "No dossiers yet." and a link "Create one in the dossier manager →".

With dossiers present, an "Export client status report (CSV)" button downloads a spreadsheet, and three summary cards count total dossiers, ready and blocked. If any dossier has a deadline within 30 days (or overdue), a strip appears: "⏳ N dossiers with a deadline in the next 30 days", an optional "N overdue" chip, "soonest first", and up to eight dossier chips each showing ID, due date, a relative label and owner.

Each dossier row is calm by default: the ID, title, submission type (plus "· CS-BE" if applicable); an Owner / Client / Due column (missing values read "—" or "none set"); a mini module tower; and ONE primary status chip — "Ready to file", a count like "3/7 modules", or "Blocked" (a past-due open task outranks the gate). A quiet per-row "Details" expander holds the fee chip ("Fee paid", "Fee waived", or "Fee due" with amount and currency — no placeholder while loading), any litigation clock ("NOA: 12d for brand to act" or "stay: 8d remaining", each with an on-demand provenance popover for anchor date, source and counting rule), and collaboration chips (assignees and open-task count, plus "⛔ blocked"). Links "Open →" and "Viewer" end the row.

You navigate to the Registry page. Heading "Product registry" with a "Register product +" toggle. A "Record only." notice states that registering or changing status logs a record in your workspace and does not transmit or file anything with Health Canada — update these to mirror what Health Canada has already told you. A "Right-to-Sell deadlines" strip lists per-product due dates (overdue ones flagged). Registrations list as rows, or "No registrations yet. Register a product once its dossier reaches NOC." An "Annual notification checklist" card (with the current year appended) explains: "Tracked on the registry service for this workspace: each tick records who signed it and when, and lands on the audit event stream. (The filings themselves still happen with Health Canada — sources in Help.)" Each ticked item strikes through and shows a "✓ signed by …" line naming the signer's email and a UTC timestamp.

The Correspondence page is headed "Correspondence & notices" with a "Record only." notice: everything here logs a record and does not transmit to Health Canada; filing happens only through the guided journey's transmit step (CESG). A "Dossier" field pre-fills with your first dossier (placeholder "e123456"); pressing "Open" reveals three stacked panels — a HC "Notice inbox", a "Correspondence hub", and a "Form V / NOA register" tracking PM(NOC) statutory clocks (the s.6 action window and 24-month stay). Until you pick one: "Pick a dossier to see its correspondence, notices and NOA clocks."
